packages.name: @tuix/view
packages.summary: Builds terminal views with text, layout, style, and cache helpers.
packages.purpose: The @tuix/view package creates terminal views. A view has width, height, and a render function. You compose views with layout helpers. You style views with ANSI helpers from this package.
packages.whenToUse: Use this package when you build terminal layouts. Import it for text, stack, box, and style helpers. Use it inside Model-View-Update (MVU) view functions.
keyExports: text — Create a text view from a string
empty — Create an empty view for spacing
vstack — Stack views from top to bottom
hstack — Place views side by side
box — Draw a border around a view
center — Center a view within a width
styledText — Create text with a style object
bold / dim / italic / underline — Apply text styles
red / green / blue — Apply foreground colors
stringWidth — Measure display width of a string
ViewCache — Cache rendered views
memoizeRender — Memoize a view render
isView — Check if a value is a view

packages.name: @tuix/runtime
packages.summary: Runs Model-View-Update (MVU) apps with commands, subscriptions, and hooks.
packages.purpose: The @tuix/runtime package runs the application loop. It processes messages and updates the model. It renders views and executes commands. It also manages subscriptions and runtime hooks.
packages.whenToUse: Use this package to start a terminal app with runApp. Use Cmd and Sub for side effects and streams. Pass hooks to connect reactive or logging code.
keyExports: runApp — Start an MVU component with optional config
createRuntime — Create a runtime instance
Cmd.none / Cmd.delay / Cmd.fetch / Cmd.exec — Built-in commands
Cmd.batch / Cmd.map / Cmd.fromEffect — Compose commands
Sub.none / Sub.interval / Sub.fromStream — Built-in subscriptions
Sub.batch / Sub.map — Compose subscriptions
createHooks / composeHooks — Build and merge runtime hooks
bootstrap — Register default modules and app modules
ModuleRegistry — Access modules from @tuix/core re-exports

packages.name: @tuix/reactive
packages.summary: Provides runes and a Model-View-Update (MVU) bridge for reactive state.
packages.purpose: The @tuix/reactive package manages reactive state with runes. Named $state fields map to the model. bindMvuPush sends set messages to the runtime. Hooks sync runes after model updates.
packages.whenToUse: Use this package for $state, $derived, and $effect. Pass a name string to $state for model fields. Use createReactiveHooks with runApp for MVU sync.
keyExports: $state — Create reactive state; pass a name string for model keys
$states — Create named state runes from an object
$derived — Compute a value from other runes
$effect — Run a side effect when dependencies change
$bindable — Create state with validate and transform options
bindMvuPush — Bind named $set to MVU set messages
createReactiveHooks — Build RuntimeHooks for model sync
ReactiveContext — Hold model state and registered effects
registerKeyHandler — Register a key handler for the session
beginViewHydration / endViewHydration — Hydrate runes from the model
